 Rain brings temporary relief as Southeast Asia battles fires and toxic haze
 Rain has offered brief relief from wildfires in Indonesia, but underground peat fires continue to burn. Toxic haze has spread across Southeast Asia, causing school closures and respiratory illnesses.
